title: Data Erasure Provisions Applying to Each Northbeam Renew Trade-In Programme
content:
Whether the retailer must destroy the data on a device before it is resold, the ways the data may be destroyed, and whether an erasure certificate is issued to the customer are set by the Northbeam Renew Trade-In programme the agreement is written under.

| Renew programme | Data destroyed before resale | Ways the data may be destroyed | Erasure certificate issued to the customer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | required | verified factory reset | no |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | required | verified factory reset or certified erasure software | no |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | required | verified factory reset | no |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | required | verified factory reset or certified erasure software | no |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | required | certified erasure software or physical destruction | yes |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | required | certified erasure software or physical destruction | yes |

Every Renew programme requires the data to be destroyed. What differs between them is the range of ways allowed and whether a certificate goes to the customer: physical destruction is open only to the two business programmes, and those same two are the only programmes on which an erasure certificate is issued.
